name: Campingplatz Kupferschmiede
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Kupferschmiede is located in the municipality of Chieming in the Austrian federal state of Tirol. The surroundings are characterized by the Alpen and offer a quiet, close-to-nature atmosphere. Nearby are hiking trails and ski areas that can be used seasonally. The site has sanitary facilities, electricity connections, and pitches for motorhomes and tents. A small shop supplies guests with basic foodstuffs. The facilities are functional and designed for the needs of camping guests.
